    return ads, ops, dev, cap

print(f"day{day0} cash ${cash0:,.0f}  ({weeks} weeks to day {END})")
hist = []
for wk in range(weeks):
    rebill=0.0; firstbill=0.0; compute_units=0.0; tot_leads=0.0; tot_new=0.0; tot_churn=0.0
    for g,s in G.items():
        sat = s['subs']/s['cap']
        slow = cap_slow(sat)
        ad_leads = plan_ad[g]/1000.0*eff[g]*7
        leads = org_leads[g]*(1.0+0.005*wk) + ad_leads     # organic mild growth
        new = leads*conv[g]*slow
        churn = s['subs']*(7.0/30.0)*(1.0-s['surv'])
        # re-bill: (7/30 of subs) * survival * arpu  ; first-bill: new * promo
        rebill += s['subs']*(7.0/30.0)*s['surv']*s['arpu']
        firstbill += new*s['promo']
        compute_units += s['subs']*s['usage']*7
        tot_leads += leads; tot_new+=new; tot_churn+=churn
        # update
        s['subs'] = s['subs'] - churn + new
        s['cap'] *= (1.0+s['capg'])**(1.0/52.0)
    compute = compute_units*0.0  # placeholder
    # compute cost: units * blended tcost (weight by group)
    compute_cost = 0.0
    # recompute compute cost properly (use post-update subs avg ~ pre; approx with current)
    for g,s in G.items():
        compute_cost += s['subs']*s['usage']*7*s['tcost']
    ads = sum(plan_ad.values())*7
    ops=43000*7; dev=46500*7; capc=28000*7
    lead_acq = tot_leads*0.5
    subrev = rebill+firstbill
    opex = ads+ops+dev+capc+lead_acq+compute_cost
    net = subrev-opex
    cash += net
    tot_subs = sum(s['subs'] for s in G.items().__iter__().__next__()[1].values()) if False else sum(s['subs'] for s in G.values())
    hist.append((day0+(wk+1)*7, cash, subrev, net, compute_cost, tot_subs))
    if wk<6 or wk in (11,25,40) or (wk+1) in (1,4,12,26):
        print(f"  wk{wk+1} d{day0+(wk+1)*7}: subrev ${subrev:,.0f} (rebill ${rebill:,.0f} fb ${firstbill:,.0f}) compute ${compute_cost:,.0f} net ${net:+,.0f} -> cash ${cash:,.0f}  subs {tot_subs:,.0f}  newsubs {tot_new:,.0f}")
